user_outcomes: Separate supplied evidence from interpretation and produce a locally reviewable candidate
anti_goals: Do not publish, send, rank people, spend funds or modify an external system
target_contexts: Local no-effect demonstration of the reusable Product Contract

actors.description: Human who supplies the review purpose and accepts, rejects or corrects the local candidate.
responsibilities: Review uncertainty and record final local disposition
actors.authority_source: Explicit participation in the local review session

actors.description: Local analysis component that classifies supplied text into evidence, interpretation and uncertainty.

inputs.description: User-supplied text and source references selected for the local review.
inputs.minimum_sufficiency: At least one attributable source fragment or an explicit statement that no source was supplied
inputs.freshness_policy: Bound to the exact local session input and repository frontier

classes.collection_scope: Only text and source references intentionally supplied for this review
classes.minimization_rule: Do not infer identity or join external contexts
classes.retention_limit: End of the local demonstration session

analysis_effects.description: Produce a local candidate separating observed input, interpretation, uncertainty and missing evidence.

human_gates.trigger: Before the local candidate is treated as the session outcome
human_gates.expires_after: End of the local session or any input change

contestability.challenge_input_scope: Source attribution, classification, uncertainty and missing-evidence statements

dependencies.relationship: May express the bounded review request without creating execution admission

receipts.purpose: Record the human-reviewed local disposition and successor state.
assertions: The disposition is bound to the exact local input and candidate
non_effects: The disposition was not published or executed outside the local session

criteria.metric: Every derived statement is linked to supplied evidence or marked as interpretation or uncertainty
criteria.falsification_condition: Any derived factual claim lacks source lineage or uncertainty marking

excluded_artifacts: Named ecosystem products, future versions, external runtimes and third-party dependencies

assertions: Product boundary described for the declared version and frontier
Effects are descriptive and denied by default
Human gates and contestability are explicit
